title: Scholarships
description: Needs-based awards cover tuition, books, hostel fees, and exams so students don't have to pause school mid-year. Headteachers verify each recipient, and donors receive receipts every term.
teaser: Tuition, books, hostel, and exams covered so students stay in school.
bullets: Needs-based awards verified by headteachers and ward committees
Covers tuition, hostel, lab fees, books, and exam costs
Receipts and progress updates shared with donors each term
impact: Impact: 100+ scholarships funded since 2023 with 95% year-over-year retention.

title: Mentorship
description: Weekly calls and career prep with Nepali mentors who understand the journey. Mentors check in on attendance, grades, and goals so first-generation students stay on track.
teaser: Weekly calls and career coaching from Nepali mentors who understand the journey.
bullets: Weekly check-ins on attendance, grades, and personal goals
Career sessions with Nepali tech professionals
Peer study groups and accountability circles
impact: Impact: 40+ mentors volunteering weekly to coach students across Dhading.

title: Device Support
description: Laptops and tablets placed in rural classrooms with on-site setup, maintenance guidance, and solar backups where needed so students can study and code.
teaser: Laptops and tablets with setup so rural classrooms can study and code.
bullets: On-site setup, maintenance guidance, and solar backups where needed
Shared labs with usage checklists for responsible care
Offline learning resources pre-loaded for areas without reliable internet
impact: Impact: 10+ devices placed in rural classrooms since 2023.
